administration.sw-privileges.roles: Resolved through the runtime-composed key `sw-privileges.roles.${role}`, so the duplicates cannot be referenced statically and the namespace keeps its own translations.
administration.sw-privileges.permissionType: Resolved through the runtime-composed key `sw-privileges.permissionType.` + type, same as sw-privileges.roles.
administration.sw-settings-logging.list: Log level labels are resolved dynamically via `sw-settings-logging.list.level${level}`.
administration.sw-media.sidebar.actions.delete: Reachable through the dynamic quick-action key `sw-media.sidebar.actions.${option.id}`, so the entry has to stay even though some call sites reference it statically.
administration.sw-theme: Theme configuration field labels (`sw-theme.…label`) are auto-constructed from the theme config structure, not authored as reusable UI strings, so they keep their own labels.

administration.sw-category.base.products.dynamicProduct: The video exists in German only; an empty URL hides the link in every other locale.
Label of the German-only video link; stays empty wherever videoUrl is empty.
